title: Python
tagline: Master Python for automation, data processing, and backend development.
description: Python is the fastest way into automation, data work, and backend development. This program builds real fluency — from core syntax through data structures, automation scripting, and data processing — so you can write Python that actually does useful work, not just pass syntax quizzes.
outcomes: Write clean, efficient Python for automation and data tasks
Process and analyze data with Pandas and NumPy
Build simple backend services with Flask
Work confidently with APIs, files, and databases

topics: Build an automation script or data pipeline
Build and deploy a small Flask API

projects: Build a data-processing pipeline that cleans and analyzes a real dataset
Build and deploy a small Flask API

faqs.q: Is this a good first programming course?
faqs.a: Yes — we start from zero and build up. Python is one of the most beginner-friendly languages to learn deeply.

faqs.q: Will this help with data analyst or backend roles?
faqs.a: Both — the program splits between automation/backend (Flask, APIs) and data processing (Pandas, NumPy), so you can lean toward either path afterward.

faqs.q: What's the difference between Live and Self-Paced?
faqs.a: Live batches include instructor-led sessions, real-time doubt clearing, and mentorship. Self-Paced gives you the recorded content on your own schedule. Both include the same projects and certificate.
